title: Map each telemetry URN to its telemetry/ directory of signal files

facts.note: Signal files live under telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/; the manifest is generated from telemetry/{domain}/{resource}/*.json.
Planner artifacts that declare telemetry: URNs, signal files, or the generated telemetry manifest.
Candidate signal only; must be confirmed by a telemetry URN, a telemetry/ path, or manifest generation in scope.

values: telemetry URN declared, edited or renamed
signal file added, renamed or removed
facts.note: Diff-level observer needed to detect telemetry URN / signal-file / manifest-generation changes.

values: plane or measure outside controlled list
metric without measure / event with measure
facts.note: Detector over existing telemetry declarations and files; also fires on pre-existing noncompliance.

fires: A wagon or acceptance declares, edits or renames a telemetry:{theme}:{segments} URN
A signal file is added, renamed or removed under telemetry/
A task validates or reviews existing telemetry URNs, their directories or signal filenames
An existing telemetry URN has no matching telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/ directory
An existing signal file uses a plane or measure outside the controlled lists, a metric lacks a measure, or an event carries one
The telemetry manifest is generated or its generation input is changed
doesNotFire: Plan edits that declare no telemetry URNs, touch nothing under telemetry/ and do not involve the telemetry manifest
Non-telemetry artifact URNs (covered by the general artifact-naming grammar)
A task merely mentioning the word 'event' or 'metric' with no telemetry URN, telemetry/ path or manifest in scope

given: A plan, wagon or acceptance declares telemetry:{theme}:{segments} URNs, or work touches, validates or generates from signal files under telemetry/.
when: You author, edit, rename or validate a telemetry URN, its signal files, or the manifest built from them.
then: Keep each URN's signals in telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/ as files named {signal-type}.{plane}[.{measure}].json, with a measure suffix on metric signals and none on event signals.
prefer: Split the URN's ':' and '.' into path segments (telemetry:mechanic:decision.choice -> telemetry/mechanic/decision/choice/).
Metrics like metric.db.count.json; events like event.be.json.
Planes: ui, ux, be, nw, db, st, tm, sc, au, fn, if. Measures: count, duration, latency, size, rate, percentage.
avoid: Metric files without a measure suffix.
Event files with a measure suffix.
Planes or measures outside the controlled lists.
Hand-editing the manifest; it is generated from telemetry/{domain}/{resource}/*.json.
why: A deterministic URN-to-path mapping lets tooling resolve URNs to signal files and generate the manifest from the filesystem; signal type (OpenTelemetry metric vs analytics event) decides whether a measure is needed.
evidence: Every declared telemetry:{theme}:{segments} URN resolves to an existing directory telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/.
Each file in that directory matches {signal-type}.{plane}[.{measure}].json with measure present iff signal-type is metric.
Plane and measure tokens are members of the controlled lists.
The telemetry manifest is generated from telemetry/{domain}/{resource}/*.json (not hand-authored).
verifier_detail: URN form: telemetry:{theme}:{segments}; directory: telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/ (per example, '.' in segments becomes a path separator).
signal_type term (metric vs event): metric = OpenTelemetry metric, requires measure suffix; event = analytics event, no measure suffix.
telemetry_axes term (the controlled planes and measures): planes = [ui, ux, be, nw, db, st, tm, sc, au, fn, if]; measures (metrics only) = [count, duration, latency, size, rate, percentage].
Source example: telemetry:mechanic:decision.choice -> telemetry/mechanic/decision/choice/ (metric.db.count.json, metric.be.duration.json, event.be.json).
Manifest generation input (source wording, verbatim): telemetry/{domain}/{resource}/*.json.
